go.mod: with only single line requirements the new one follows the last.
-- changes --
[{"name":"golang.org/x/net","ecosystem":"golang","to":"0.38.0","method":"override","file":"go.mod"}]

replace github.com/acme/lib => ../lib
-- out:go.mod --
